title: Permissive Information-Flow Analysis for Large Language Models
authors: Shoaib Ahmed Siddiqui; Radhika Gaonkar; Boris Köpf; David Krueger; Andrew Paverd; Ahmed Salem; Shruti Tople; Lukas Wutschitz; Menglin Xia; Santiago Zanella-Béguelin
why_relevant: Proposes an information-flow label propagation defense for RAG/LLM-agent settings where retrieved documents may be poisoned or untrusted, addressing integrity/confidentiality robustness in retrieval pipelines.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on system-level taint tracking rather than core RAG robustness methods; tangential to noise/conflict/calibration themes.
